paper_title: Constraining axion-like particles using the white dwarf initial-final mass relation
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on the y-axis of Figure 1
notes: Paper derives a new 95% CL stellar-evolution exclusion ('WD-IFMR') on the ALP-photon coupling for keV-MeV mass ALPs using the white dwarf initial-final mass relation from double white dwarf binaries, excluding part of the 'cosmological triangle'. No numerical table of the exclusion contour is provided; the boundary is shown only in Figures 1/15. Data points extracted from explicit text statements: 10 keV ALPs excluded at g=0.794e-10 GeV^-1; 316 keV ALPs at g=3.16e-9 GeV^-1 produce the lowest (excluded) IFMR while unconstrained by HB stars; 630 keV ALPs with g=1e-5 GeV^-1 (inside cosmological triangle) are excluded. The bound relaxes at high g where the ALP decay length falls below the He-burning shell thickness (~0.007 R_sun), so the excluded region is a closed contour not fully captured by these points. Not a dark-matter search, so no local DM density assumption.
